svg.aria-label: June 17, 2026 — Statue of Liberty arrives in New York Harbor (June 17, 1885) — 141st anniversary; the French frigate Isère sails in at left under a tricolor, Lady Liberty stands at right in pre-patina copper holding her torch aloft, a shipping crate at center bears the date.

g.text: LIBERTY · ARRIVES · NEW · YORK · HARBOR · 141 · YEARS
